# Godot技能系统知识图谱

## 技能系统总览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SR[SkillResource] --> SB[SkillBar]
    SR --> ST[SkillTree]
    SB --> UI[UI (quick slot)]
    ST --> AS[ActiveSkill]
    ST --> PS[PassiveSkill]
    AS --> AN[Animation]
    PS --> EB[EventBus]
    EB --> PS
    IN[Inheritance] --> SR
    AN --> IN
```
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 02:31] 自定义技能栏概念  
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 05:06] 技能作为资源的讨论  
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 08:34] 被动技能使用事件总线  

## 新技能创建流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    I[Idea] --> D[Design]
    D --> RC[Create Skill Resource]
    RC --> AC[Create Animation]
    AC --> AB[Add to Skill Bar]
    AB --> IT[Integrate into Skill Tree]
    IT --> T[Test in Game]
    T --> DP[Deploy]
```
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 01:02] 开始设计新技能  
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 05:06] 创建技能资源  
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 06:30] 使用类继承  
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 06:40] 测试技能  

## 主动与被动技能机制
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    PI[Player Input] --> AS[ActiveSkill]
    AS --> AE[Skill Effect]
    AE --> CD[Cooldown]
    GE[Game Event] --> PS[PassiveSkill]
    PS --> EB[EventBus]
    EB --> PE[Skill Effect]
```
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 08:20] 主动技能触发  
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 08:31] 被动技能通过事件总线  
[BV1QV5j6BE8c P1 08:56] 被动技能测试  

## Godot技能系统学习路径
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    GB[Godot Basics] --> RE[Resources]
    RE --> IN[Inheritance]
    IN --> UI[Custom Skill Bar UI]
    UI --> EV[Event Bus System]
    EV --> AN[Animation Creation]
    AN --> TE[Testing Skills]
    TE --> DP[Deploying]
```
